name: Walking Constellations
introDiscord:
Constellations have climbed down from the sky.

They walk around on metal legs.

Shizuki's response:

'STARS HAVE KNEES NOW.'
introTwitch:
Constellations have climbed down from the sky.

They walk around on metal legs.

Shizuki's response:

'STARS HAVE KNEES NOW.'

walking-constellations-approach.prompt: Three impossible routes open across Walking Constellations.

left.message: A Constellation Automaton rearranges its stars into a battle stance.

right.message: A coffer hangs from a tiny artificial constellation.

forward.message: A constellation shaped like a resting animal projects soothing light.
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

walking-constellations-depths.prompt: Deeper within Walking Constellations, three paths bend through the unstable Nexus.

left.message:
Star Candies sit inside Orion-adjacent machinery.

Astronomers may complain.

forward.message:
One Berry rests under Shizuki's handmade constellation:

'*   *
  *
 * *'

Label:

'BERRY.

Do not fact-check.'

walking-constellations-threshold.prompt: Near Mechanical Zodiac, three final routes cross the edge of reality.

left.message: A slow-moving constellation bathes you in restorative starlight.
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

right.message: A cache rotates around a mechanical moon.

forward.message: An Automaton unfolds into a massive star pattern.

bossPromptDiscord:
Mechanical Zodiac activates.

Twelve constellations rotate around one central machine.

Use /yes to enter or /no to reject astronomy with moving
parts.
bossPromptTwitch:
Mechanical Zodiac activates.

Twelve constellations rotate around one central machine.

Use !yes to enter or !no to reject astronomy with moving
parts.
bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Mechanical Zodiac. The impossible guardian will wait.

boss.revealText:
The stars lock into one enormous mechanism.

Zodiac Engine reveals itself!

completionText:
The constellations scatter.

Shizuki's Berry constellation remains.

Canon by persistence.
